counterexamples.fact: _queried_sources counts any DISCOVERY_RESULT source_id with no current decision epoch, completeness, exact query, source epoch, source digest, or source-set binding.
counterexamples.consequence: A stale or partial receipt can suppress current discovery and permit selection while a cheaper identity remains undiscovered.

counterexamples.fact: V4 scans visible_tools only and never merges discovery_receipts[].tools.
counterexamples.consequence: A completed receipt can contain a cheaper discovered identity while V4 still selects a more expensive visible identity unless an external mutator performs an unproved merge.

counterexamples.fact: V4 returns PROBE for an unknown required capability without checking explicit safe-probe permission.
counterexamples.consequence: The frozen safe-probe-choice obligation is not established by the active V4 bytes.
